description: This file defines a 'Grid' component using LightningJS Blits framework. It specifies grid layout properties, rendering template, and helper methods for calculating element positions.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: A fixed grid component for layout of items with configurable columns, gaps, and card sizes.

methods.name: xPos
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for an item based on its index.

methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for an item based on its index.
